authority: ADR 0021 — automated workflow evidence plus the maintainer's merge after every required check is green is the sole acceptance record
note: One entry per requirement this increment accepts by merge or leaves open: every open finding in docs/roadmap/findings.json, every roadmap package that is not delivered, every Gate B criterion, and the named requirements with no finding of their own. reference points at the requirement text; runtime_owner at the code that carries the behaviour; tests at the proofs on the pull request head; workflows at the CI jobs (file#job) that run them; artifacts at committed evidence files or uploaded workflow artifacts (file#name); decision at the governing record; outstanding at what remains. branches and branch_evidence name the agent branch and the files it carries while an entry is pending integration; they move into the head fields when it lands. composer acceptance:check verifies every claim, and composer acceptance:summary regenerates docs/roadmap/acceptance-summary.md and the marked STATUS.md blocks. No human checkbox, manual browser, Safari or right-to-left review, or follow-up acceptance commit is part of acceptance.

states.delivered: On the pull request head: out of the live indexes, cited by CHANGELOG.md, proven by a test in a required CI job. Accepted when the maintainer merges the pull request after every required check is green.
states.pending-integration: Complete on the named agent branch but not yet on the pull request head; it stays in the live indexes and flips to delivered, with its branch evidence, when the branch lands.
states.open: Outstanding on every branch; the outstanding note says what remains and who decides it.

entries.requirement: Unrelated record writes under one definition hold a shared generation lease instead of the exclusive definition-wide mutex.
Business commits stage unsequenced events and a bounded sequencer assigns journal order after commit.
Fan-out materialises independent consumer receipts claimed by batched workers, so a slow or failing consumer delays no other.
Declared queues own durable fenced permits claimed with portable leasing, with fair turns and bounded recovery after SIGKILL.
Every hot ledger declares its retention budget and drains in time-budgeted adaptive batches at twice the peak expiry rate.
Durable gauges use bounded probes, exact counts move to an operator-only census with a stated cost, and operation-class metrics carry closed labels.
Generated queries, reports and exports stay within declared plan, row, byte and time bounds at aged volume.
A stateless application tier with six worker pool classes preserves policy, generation and transaction semantics with fairness and backpressure.
entries.outstanding: The head implements per-site cumulative export byte budgets and proves two independent application replicas, worker permits, fair turns, shared idempotency and coordinated drain. Complete the combined three-engine evidence and the deployment-level connection-fairness qualification; the documented load-balancer condition is not an App HTTP concurrency limiter.

entries.requirement: Per-engine storage amplification is measured and published, and a 30% free-space reserve is enforced.
Two writers on unrelated records under one definition overlap, while a schema transition waits for in-flight writers and fences new ones.
Concurrent commits do not contend on a singleton event head, and sequencing is replay-safe across sequencer crashes and races.
Independent consumer receipts are claimed in batches and a hung or poison consumer delays no unrelated consumer.
Declared-queue claims use fenced permits with no over-claim, no starvation and bounded recovery after SIGKILL.
Idempotency retention sustains at least twice the peak expiry rate with exposed retention metrics and a readiness verdict.
Every hot correctness ledger declares a retention budget, and audit is pruned only after a verifiable anchor and a restorable archive.
Monitoring runs no unbudgeted table-scale exact count on the primary; exact figures are an operator diagnostic with a stated cost.
Point-in-time recovery captures coordinates on every engine, replays to a chosen point, refuses an unreachable target and enforces the ordering rule.
entries.outstanding: Native replay, coordinate, ordering, archive-gap, interruption and deduplication drills pass the three-engine recovery workflow on candidate 038bc9fc. Complete qualification inside the exact release artifacts under the Beta 1 build-once chain.
